# Radio

Radio represents one labeled option; RadioGroup coordinates mutually exclusive options and their shared selected value.

## Import

```tsx
import { Radio } from '@vellira-ui/react';
```

## API

API details are generated from `packages/react/API.md`.

<!-- api-docgen:start web.RadioProps.RadioProps -->

| Prop               | Type                         | Required | Description                                           |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`            | `string`                     | Yes      | Value submitted by the radio control.                 |
| `label`            | `ReactNode`                  | No       | Text label displayed next to the radio control.       |
| `description`      | `ReactNode`                  | No       | Additional supporting text displayed below the label. |
| `checked`          | `boolean`                    | No       | Current checked state for controlled usage.           |
| `defaultChecked`   | `boolean`                    | No       | Initial checked state for uncontrolled usage.         |
| `onCheckedChange`  | `(checked: boolean) => void` | No       | Called when the standalone checked state changes.     |
| `disabled`         | `boolean`                    | No       | Disables user interaction.                            |
| `required`         | `boolean`                    | No       | Marks the radio control as required.                  |
| `error`            | `string`                     | No       | Validation error message displayed under the radio.   |
| `size`             | `RadioSize`                  | No       | Radio control size.                                   |
| `wrapperClassName` | `string`                     | No       | Class name applied to the clickable label wrapper.    |
| `icon`             | `ReactNode`                  | No       | Icon rendered inside the component.                   |
| `color`            | `RadioColor`                 | No       | —                                                     |

<!-- api-docgen:end web.RadioProps.RadioProps -->

## When To Use

- Use Radio inside RadioGroup when several mutually exclusive options belong to one choice.
- For standalone controlled selection, pass checked and onCheckedChange, or initialize an uncontrolled radio with defaultChecked.
- Choose Checkbox instead for independent selections that do not form a single-choice set.

## Accessibility

- Radio renders a native radio input and clickable label; supply a meaningful visible label.
- Connect descriptions and errors to the control and preserve keyboard focus visibility.
- Use RadioGroup for related options so they share the group name, selection state, and keyboard interaction.
- Keep required, disabled, and invalid states consistent with the surrounding form.
